name: xtyle-components
title: Xtyle components
description: The host surface a xtyle component fragment fills: an inert template plus sandboxed hooks and handlers, rendered into the component's shadow root.

Glyphs for the icon roster: a data fill of inner SVG bodies on a 24x24 grid, keyed by name. Adds new names and replaces built-in ones; later fills win, so a mod loaded after another reskins it.

Silhouettes for the reveal component: a data fill of `clip-path` definitions with an optional grip inset, keyed by name. A shape is a part a box is cut to rather than an icon, so it is its own vocabulary.

Primitives for the icon builder: a data fill of composable shape and symbol parts, keyed by name. A separate vocabulary from the finished glyphs in xtyle.icons, because a primitive is a part an icon is built from rather than an icon.
